scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed with a Paul Tol-inspired categorical palette, clear rank-color legend, and useful +N descendant badges, but the tree occupies only the top half of the viewport leaving a large dead zone below.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout uses no quantitative size/area encoding so lie-factor and baseline rules don't apply; SVG dimensions are data-driven, color encodes categorical rank correctly, but node key functions use name+depth string concatenation instead of a guaranteed unique ID, creating a minor permutation-robustness fragility.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() is called before new transitions on node click or expand-all, so rapid clicks during a 500ms animation will cause conflicting transitions and jumping elements; all other checks pass (search is debounced 200ms, pointer events prevent touch jitter, no cross-view dispatch, no stale scale closures).
scores.cognitive_load_note: Progressive disclosure keeps ~15 nodes visible by default, 6-rank color legend is within working memory limits, and collapsed +N badges convey depth without exposing it — cognitive load is well-managed for a 200-node hierarchy.

proposer: Removed 6 lines: 3 from redundant nodeEnter text setup (text-anchor, x, and text are all re-applied in the nodeMerge block), 3 from compacting `countDescendants` into a reduce one-liner. 641 → 635 lines.
